reasons.text: Buys feedstock inside a closed loop of 4 recyclers trading the same material (6% of its feedstock)
Energy charges do not match units x tariff on 100% of bills (worst bill charged 87% of expected)
Uploaded plant photos are near-duplicates of photos registered by 1 other plant(s)
100% of certificate tonnes were sold below the cost of recycling (average 0.69x the cost floor)
51% of all certificates were generated in a single month
51% of certificate tonnes were generated more than 45 days after the processing month

model_signals.label: membership of a closed trading loop

inspection_checklist: Trace the material flow between the plants in the loop (weighbridge slips, vehicle GPS); the same tonnes may be invoiced round a ring.
Verify the electricity bills directly with the DISCOM (units, tariff, amount); the uploaded copies do not reconcile.
Compare the plant against the entities sharing its identifiers (bank, address, director, photos); consider a joint inspection.
Ask for the plant's cost sheet; certificates priced below the cost of recycling imply the processing cost was never incurred.
Cross-check the certificate generation dates and category mix against the plant's process route and stock registers.
